capabilities: Encrypt a note's content with AES-256-GCM and a password
Unlock a locked note inline without a modal
Re-lock notes on leaving the note, losing window focus, or after a timeout
extras: Desktop only because it uses Node's built-in crypto. A forgotten password cannot be recovered by design, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Some lock plugins only cover the screen while the .md file stays in plaintext, so the author built one that encrypts what is written to disk.
problem: Screen-lock plugins leave the .md file in plaintext on disk, so opening it in any text editor reveals the content.
summary: Note encryption plugin that encrypts a note's content with AES-256-GCM on disk and unlocks it inline after password entry.
